result:
Looking at the qlang documentation, I'll work through each task carefully, using the combinators, literals, and verbs described.

S1: Count open issues with "bug" labels (case-insensitive)
- Filter for state="open", filter where labels array contains "bug" (lowercased), count
- Note: `any` applies a modifier to find if any element matches

S2: Group open issues by assignee (excluding null), count per assignee
- Filter for state="open" and assignee != null, group by assignee, count each group

S3: Top 3 open issues by priority (missing=0), ties by smaller id
- Filter for state="open", sort by priority desc then id asc, take 3, extract ids

S4: Package names with "^" from both dependency objects, deduplicated, sorted
- Get entries from both objects, filter for "^" versions, extract names, deduplicate, sort

S5: Top 2 customers by total order value (sum of qty*price per item)
- Group by customer, compute total per order, sum per customer, sort desc, round to 2 decimals

S6: Users with profile.city="berlin" (case-insensitive), emails lowercase, sorted
- Check profile exists, is map, city field matches "berlin" case-insensitively

S7: Error count per service (case-insensitive ERROR, parse pipe-separated)
- Split lines by space, filter for ERROR (case-insensitive), extract service name, group and count

S8: Average salary per department (case-insensitive grouping, report lowercase)
- Parse CSV, skip header, filter non-empty salaries, group by dept lowercase, average

S9: Top 3 tags by count (published articles, case-insensitive, count once per article)
- Filter published, extract tags lowercased and deduplicated, flatten, group, sort by count desc

S10: Active services (enabled=true) mapped to port (null if missing)
- Get services entries, filter enabled=true, build map with service names to ports

S11: Distinct categories of products with stock>0, lowercased, sorted
- Filter stock>0 (treating missing as 0), extract categories lowercased, deduplicate, sort

S12: 3 most frequent words (case-insensitive) from sentence
- Split by spaces, lowercase, group and count, sort by count desc then word asc

S13: Events grouped by user with count and earliest timestamp, sorted by user
- Group by user, convert to entries, extract user/count/min-timestamp

S14: Server names (region starts with "eu-", status not "down"), joined by comma
- Parse pipe-separated, filter comments/blanks, filter region and status, sort by uptime desc, join names

S1: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug")) | count
S2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~/assignee * count
S3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :priority | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 | * /id
S4: [(/dependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0) (/devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0)] | flat | distinct | sort
S5: groupBy ~/customer * (* ((at :items | coalesce []) | * (/qty | mul (/price)) | sum) | sum) | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) | take 2 | * {:customer /0 :total (/1 | round 2)}
S6: /data /users | filter ~(/profile | if ~(ne null) ~(if ~(type | eq ::map) ~((/city | lower | eq "berlin") !| false) ~(false)) ~(false)) | * /email | * lower | sort
S7: lines | filter ~((split " ") | /1 | lower | eq "error") | * ((split " ") | /2) | groupBy * count
S8: lines | * (split ",") | drop 1 | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | * {:dept (/1 | lower) :salary (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/dept * (* /salary | avg | round 1)
S9: filter ~(/published | eq true) | * ((at :tags | coalesce []) * lower | distinct) | flat | groupBy * count | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) | take 3 | * {:tag /0 :count /1}
S10: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 /enabled | eq true) | reduce {} ~(. + {(/0): (/1 | at :port | coalesce null)})
S11: filter ~((at :stock | coalesce 0) | gt 0) | * (/category | lower) | distinct | sort
S12: "The cat and the Hat and THE bat sat on a mat with the cat" | split " " | * lower | groupBy * count | entries | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) | take 3 | * {:word /0 :count /1}
S13: groupBy ~/user | entries | * {:user /0 :count (/1 | count) :first (/1 | * /ts | min)} | sort ~(/user)
S14: lines | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(ne "") | * (split "|") | filter ~(/1 | lower | startsWith "eu-") | filter ~(/2 | ne "down") | sort ~(/3 | parseJson | desc) | * /0 | join ","
